job_desc:
Arnsoft is seeking a highly skilled AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy advanced AI-driven systems that solve real-world business challenges. This role is heavily focused on building intelligent, agentic, and production-grade AI solutions—including AI Agents, Private GPTs, Small Language Models (SLMs), and Virtual Advisors. 



You will work at the forefront of applied AI, leveraging state-of-the-art LLMs, multimodal systems, and deep learning techniques, while contributing to scalable backend and user-facing applications. 





 Key Responsibilities 

Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code for AI/ML applications 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and contribute to technical solutions 
Help in building and maintaining data pipelines for AI systems 
Ability to write clear documentation and collaborate in teams using Git / GitHub 
Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning 
Work directly with clients to understand their needs, communicate progress, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle 


 AI System Design & Development (Core Focus) 

Design and implement agentic AI systems with tool use, memory, reasoning, and function calling 
Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, including tokenization, embedding generation, vector indexing, retrieval strategies, and caching mechanisms 
Develop AI-powered applications using LLMs such as OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, LLaMA, and other open-source models 
Fine-tune and deploy Small Language Models (SLMs) for lightweight and domain-specific use cases 
Work with open-source language and vision-language models, including quantization and performance optimization techniques 
Implement advanced prompt engineering strategies and reasoning frameworks (e.g., chain-of-thought, structured outputs) 
Develop AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration tools 
Integrate vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) for semantic search and knowledge retrieval 
Design and deploy multimodal AI systems, including Image processing (object detection, contour detection, OCR) 
Speech systems (STT & TTS integration) 
Build and optimize deep learning models (CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs) for structured and unstructured data tasks using frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Keras 
Work with Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j) to model knowledge graphs and enhance AI reasoning 
Implement model optimization techniques such as quantization and model compression for efficient inference 
Conduct model evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement in production environments 
Create data collection, cleaning, preprocessing, and ingestion pipelines 


AI Deployment & Infrastructure 

Deploy AI systems on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) with scalable architecture 
Build production-ready APIs and backend services to orchestrate AI workflows 
Implement secure and efficient inference pipelines for real-time AI applications 
Work with structured and unstructured databases 


Full Stack Development 

Develop and maintain backend services using Python and/or Java to support AI applications 
Build or integrate frontend interfaces using React to deliver intuitive AI-powered user experiences 
Integrate third-party APIs and enterprise systems into AI solutions 
Ensure performance, scalability, and maintainability of AI-enabled applications 




Required Experience 

Education: A Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, IT, or a related engineering discipline from a Tier 1 institution 
Experience: Must have more than 1.5 years of experience 
Academic Performance: Consistent and strong academic record 
Core Concepts: Solid understanding of fundamental AI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning concepts 
Programming: Strong programming skills in Python and problem-solving ability 
Foundations: Excellent knowledge of Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS) 
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with keen attention to detail 
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
Teamwork: A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
